# Global deployment-verify whitelist (single-node / multi-node / PD pipelines).
# One extended-regex pattern per line, matched against the changed recipe path
# (e.g. `models/en/Qwen/` whitelists every Qwen recipe). Both
# pr-recipe-verify.yml and multinode-recipe-verify.yml read this file; recipes
# not matching any pattern are skipped on pull_request triggers (manual
# workflow_dispatch always runs the recipe the caller selected).
